lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day 19 of the zombie outbreak. You're locked inside a gas station, and your last bottle of water is empty.
lines.tts: [tense, low] Day nineteen of the zombie outbreak. You're locked inside a gas station, and your last bottle of water is empty.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: But you didn't skip the boring part of survival. FEMA lists a hidden water source in almost every building: the water heater.
lines.tts: [confident] But you didn't skip the boring part of survival. FEMA lists a hidden water source in almost every building. The water heater.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Forty gallons, sitting in the back room. You open the drain valve. Clean water. Weeks more. You almost laugh.
lines.tts: [relieved] Forty gallons, sitting in the back room. You open the drain valve. Clean water. Weeks more. [soft laugh] You almost laugh.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: And that's the mistake. To reach the valve, you dragged the shelves away from the back door. You never put them back.
lines.tts: [dark, slow] And that's the mistake. To reach the valve, you dragged the shelves away from the back door. [pause] You never put them back.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: 3 a.m. The back door clicks open. The latch was broken all along.
lines.tts: [whispering] Three A M. The back door clicks open. [pause] The latch was broken all along.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: There's one of them inside. Between you and everything you own.
lines.tts: [tense] There's one of them inside. Between you... and everything you own.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You run for the strongest room you have. The walk-in cooler. You pull the door shut and hold it.
lines.tts: [urgent] You run for the strongest room you have. The walk in cooler. You pull the door shut... and hold it.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Now you're sealed in the dark, your breath turning to fog, listening to it scratch at the door.
lines.tts: [whispering] Now you're sealed in the dark... your breath turning to fog... listening to it scratch at the door.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: On your belt is the cashier's handset. It's wired to the speakers outside, the ones that say 'pump four is ready.'
lines.tts: [tense, thinking] On your belt is the cashier's handset. It's wired to the speakers outside. The ones that say... pump four is ready.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You press the button, and you bang it against the wall.
lines.tts: [determined] You press the button... and you bang it against the wall.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: It turns. It follows the sound, out the back door, into the rain. You sprint, slam the door, and bury it under every shelf you own.
lines.tts: [fast, intense] It turns. It follows the sound. Out the back door, into the rain. You sprint, slam the door... and bury it under every shelf you own.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You survived your mistake. But you just told the whole county exactly where you are.
lines.tts: [slow, ominous] You survived your mistake. But you just told the whole county... exactly where you are.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: That was day nineteen. All thirty days are on my channel.
lines.tts: [softer, low] That was day nineteen. All thirty days are on my channel.
